rationale_overall: Held AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA/SPY/RKLB/ITA/SMR/BOTZ steady this quarter — Q2 2022 prints from MSFT/GOOGL were solid, RKLB posted a record $55.5M quarter (+392% y/y) plus a NASA VADR launch-services award, NuScale continued regulatory and commercialization progress, and ITA/BOTZ show no thesis-breaking news; NVDA's newly disclosed China A100/H100 export licensing requirement (~$400M revenue at risk) is a watch-item but not yet a crest signal given the AI wave is still in its buildup phase, so no remove is warranted. To broaden beyond the current AI/robotics/rockets/nuclear/defense concentration, three adds fill named-but-uncovered waves: IONQ gives pure-play early exposure to the quantum computing wave (ranked #3 next-wave) on the back of its first disclosed enterprise partnerships; FRO adds the tactical tanker/freight exposure the profile calls out under energy-and-commodity cycles, timed to a tanker-industry consolidation move and tightening charter rates; WELL opens the previously-absent aging-population demographics wave via a senior-housing operator expanding its portfolio. This brings the watchlist to 12 (cap), spread across six distinct wave buckets.
